name: OpenAI
description: OpenAI chat-completion provider. Claims the 'openai' model prefix (e.g. 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'). Wraps the canonical OAICompatClient from local-oai-provider with OpenAI's defaults (baseURL https://api.openai.com/v1, Bearer auth). Reads the API key from plugins.openai-provider.apiKey or the legacy OPENAI_API_KEY env var; backfills on first install.
